versions.changelog:
Initial release – order food delivery from TGO Yemek (Trendyol GO) in Turkey.

- Browse and search restaurants, view menus, and search for specific foods.
- Add, select, and manage delivery addresses.
- Add items to cart (basket) and clear basket if needed.
- Full order and checkout flow with 3D Secure payment support.
- Check order status and view order history.
- Environment variable setup and authentication instructions included.
